title: bidens aristosa f. fritcheyi
intro: Bidens aristosa f. fritcheyi, commonly known as a subspecies of the Bidens aristosa plant, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family Asteraceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Bidens aristosa f. fritcheyi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant also include antispasmodic, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
